funeral.name: Funeral directors
funeral.desc: Funeral homes, celebrants, cremation and burial services
profile: Pre-paid funeral plans or funds held for future services?
Procedures for identification, paperwork and cremation authorisation?

pi: Errors and sensitivity claims
Wrong person, wrong ceremony, lost ashes and delays cause distress claims. Ask about identification, tags, checklists and sign-off.
crime: Funds held in trust for future funerals. Check the trust arrangement, dishonesty cover and limit.
mdamage: Hearses, refrigeration and cremation plant. Check breakdown and loss of refrigerated stock cover.

pets.name: Pet services, kennels and grooming
pets.desc: Boarding kennels, catteries, dog grooming, trainers, walkers and pet shops
profile: Animals in your care at peak
Animals transported in your vehicles or walked off-lead in public?
Vaccination and behaviour checks required for every animal?
Written terms of service and indemnities with owners?

liab: Injury or death of animals
Escape, fights, heat stress and illness. Ask about housing separation, supervision and escape procedures. Check whether policies include care, custody and control for animals.
Dog attacks
Injury to people or other animals while walking or in daycare. Check limits and breed exclusions.
mdamage: Boarding premises are often overnight with animals inside. Ask about smoke alarms, power failure and fire evacuation for animals.

optical.name: Opticians and optometrists
optical.desc: Optometry practices, optical dispensers and eye clinics
profile: All optometrists registered with current annual practising certificates?
Lenses made in-house or sent to an external laboratory?
Retinal imaging or prescribing of therapeutic eye drops?

pi: Missed pathology
Missed glaucoma, retinal detachment or diabetic eye disease is the leading claim. Ask about screening protocols, referrals and recall systems.
Prescribing and dispensing errors
Wrong prescription, wrong lens or wrong measurements. Ask about double checks.
mdamage: Frames are small and high value. Check theft limits, stock sums and equipment breakdown.

security.name: Security and alarm companies
security.desc: Security guards, patrols, alarm installers, locksmiths and CCTV
profile: All guards hold current Private Security Personnel licences?
Hold customers' keys, codes or alarm monitoring contracts?
Any staff carrying restraint tools or working at licensed premises at night?
Contracts limit liability for failed alarms or missed events?

liab: Failure to prevent loss
Customers claim for burglary, fire or theft when a system or guard fails. Check limitation of liability clauses and the policy's response.
Assault and use of force
Allegations of excessive force or detention. Check the policy covers assault by employees and the licence status of staff.
pi: Design and monitoring errors
Wrong specification of alarms and delays in response. Include professional indemnity for system design and monitoring.
crime: Guards and installers have access to premises, keys and alarm codes. Check fidelity cover and vetting.

pest.name: Pest control and fumigation
pest.desc: Pest control, fumigation, weed control and biosecurity services
profile: Operators hold current certificates and licences for the chemicals used?
Treatment records, safety data sheets and notifications to neighbours?
Work in food premises, schools or aged care?

liab: Chemical injury and contamination
Poisoning of people, pets or food, and contamination of waterways. Check pollution exclusions and cover for sudden chemical escape.
Failure to eradicate
Customers claim for continuing infestation or structure damage, such as termites. Check guarantees and policy wording for failure to perform.
statutory: Hazardous substances rules, storage and transport. Check defence cost cover.

selfstorage.name: Self-storage and storage operators
selfstorage.desc: Self-storage facilities, container storage, furniture storage and vehicle storage
profile: Customers must insure their own goods under written terms?
Gated access, CCTV and individual unit locks?
Prohibited goods rules (gas, chemicals, batteries) enforced?

liab: Customers' goods
Fire, flood or theft of stored goods leads to customer claims. Check whether the policy covers goods in your care, and what your storage terms say about customer insurance.
mdamage: Combustible items in closed units can cause total fires. Ask about sprinklers, compartments and prohibited items.
Check flood exposure, drainage and roofing condition on older sites.

crane.name: Crane hire and heavy haulage
crane.desc: Mobile cranes, tower cranes, heavy haulage and lifting services
profile: Number of cranes and lifting units
Operators hold current certificates and cranes are inspected to schedule?
Cranes hired with operator under a 'crane hire' contract?
Work near power lines or over public areas?

liab: Crane collapse and dropped loads
Loads dropped on people and property, or crane tip-over. Ask about lift plans, ground checks, outrigger plates and load-chart compliance.
Hire terms
Whether the operator is treated as your employee or the hirer's for liability. Check contract wording and indemnities.
mdamage: High value cranes. Check agreed value, transit risks, tip-over and breakdown cover.

ruralsvc.name: Stock agents and rural merchants
ruralsvc.desc: Livestock and real estate agents in rural, farm supply merchants and rural services
profile: Livestock bought or sold on behalf of clients, including held in your care?
Credit extended to farmers on account?
Chemicals, fertilisers or seed stocked and delivered?
Value of livestock sold per year ($)

pi: Livestock trades and advice
Advice on stock purchases, grading errors and delayed payment. Check PI for advisers and agents, and limits on stock value.
liab: Product and delivery
Contaminated fertiliser or the wrong chemical applied. Check products liability and recall.
crime: Payments from buyers held before paying vendors. Check trust funds and dishonesty cover.

labs.name: Laboratories, testing and diagnostics
labs.desc: Medical laboratories, materials testing, environmental and calibration labs
profile: IANZ accreditation or equivalent in place?
Results relied on by regulators, courts or lenders?
Samples stored refrigerated or frozen on the premises?

pi: Wrong results
Missed, delayed or wrong results lead to bodily injury or large financial loss. Check limits against the biggest customer and the consequences of the testing.
Accreditation
Loss of accreditation can stop revenue and trigger claims. Check the policy wording and business interruption.
machinery: High-value instruments and refrigeration. Check breakdown, calibration and spoilage cover for samples.

avtele.name: AV, data cabling and telecom installers
avtele.desc: Audio visual, data cabling, communications, smart home and telecommunications installers
profile: Work at height on masts, towers or roofs?
Working near live power or in ceilings and risers?
Support and uptime agreements with penalties?

liab: Fire and electrical faults
Cabling in ceilings and risers, firestopping and live work. Ask about registration, testing and certificates of compliance.
Service interruption
Outages caused by cable cuts or installation errors. Check consequential loss exclusions and contract caps.
pi: Design advice
If the business designs systems or specifies equipment, check PI for under-performance and compatibility.

solar.name: Solar and renewable energy installers
solar.desc: Solar PV, batteries, EV chargers, heat pump water and wind installers
profile: Installers hold electrical registration and accreditation from the manufacturers?
Product and workmanship warranties offered to customers?
Roof penetrations or mounting on existing roofs?
System design and sizing carried out by the business?

liab: Fire from PV and batteries
DC faults, hot connections and battery thermal runaway cause serious fires. Ask about installation standards, commissioning checks and approved products.
Roof leaks and penetrations
Mounting points can compromise roof waterproofing. Ask about flashings, roofing contractor sign-off and weathertightness exclusions.
Performance claims
Customers claim when generation falls short. Check PI for design and output guarantees, and exclusions for guarantees.
gen: Inverters and batteries fail or suppliers collapse, leaving installers to honour warranties. Check supplier terms, back-to-back warranties and recall cover.

pools.name: Pool builders, spas and pool maintenance
pools.desc: Swimming pool construction, spa installation, servicing and pool shops
profile: Compliance with pool fencing rules checked on every job?

liab: Drowning and fence compliance
Barrier compliance is critical. Check inspection records and cover for injury linked to non-compliant fencing.
Leaks, structure and ground
Pool shell failure, hydrostatic uplift and leaks damaging neighbouring property. Ask about engineering and warranties.
Chemical hazards
Chlorine, acid and reactions in storage or delivery. Check pollution cover and safe handling.

arborist.name: Arborists and tree services
arborist.desc: Tree felling, pruning, stump grinding and vegetation management
profile: Workers hold current arboriculture or chainsaw qualifications?
Work near power lines or on utility networks?
Cranes or mobile elevated work platforms used for large trees?
Council tree protection rules checked before work?
Wood chipper, stump grinder and trailer values recorded in the plant register?

liab: Falling trees and property damage
Branches falling onto houses, cars, fences and power lines. Ask about rigging methods, drop zones, exclusion zones and traffic management.
Power line strikes
Contact with lines can cause outages and injury. Ask about line clearance permits, utility approvals and exclusions.
Wrong tree or protected trees
Cutting the wrong tree or a protected one. Ask about site briefing and written authorisation.
statutory: Arboriculture is among the most dangerous trades. Check training records, rescue plans and notices.

removals.name: Removalists and moving services
removals.desc: House and office removals, furniture moving, relocations and packing
profile: Number of removal trucks and vans
Goods in transit cover offered to customers, with a declared value basis?
Packing done by staff and glass or fragile items handled?
Goods stored overnight or in a warehouse?

cargo: Goods in transit and customer terms
Check the limit per item and per load, 'carrier's risk' versus all-risks cover, and what customers sign. Standard terms often cap liability by weight.
Ask about packing methods, blanket and wrap, tie-downs and truck fires.
liab: Damage to customer premises
Walls, floors and doors damaged during moves. Check property damage cover and risk assessment.
crime: Staff in customers' homes. Check dishonesty cover and vetting.

developer.name: Property developers
developer.desc: Residential and commercial developers, subdividers and project managers
profile: Total value of projects in progress ($)
Head contractor engaged under a written contract with insurance and defects obligations?
Properties sold off the plan before completion?
Funding provided by lenders requiring specific insurance conditions?

cworks: Total project cost, phased completion, delay in start-up and who insures the works. Developer vs contractor's cover should not overlap or gap.
Interest, rates and holding costs when works are delayed by loss. Ask about delay in start-up cover.
liab: Defects and long-tail liability
Developers can be responsible for defects up to 10 years. Check run-off cover, joint and several liability and builder insolvency risks.
pi: Design and project management
If the developer manages design or specifies, check cover for errors.

equine.name: Horse studs, riding schools and racing
equine.desc: Stud farms, riding schools, racing stables, trekking and horse boarding
profile: Instructors qualified with first aid and helmets compulsory?

liab: Rider and spectator injury
Falls, kicks and bolting horses. Check waivers, activity limits and exclusions for horse-riding activities.
Horses in your care
Owners' horses boarded or trained. Check care, custody and control exclusions and bailee cover.
gen: High-value horses can be insured for death and permanent loss of use. Ask about veterinary exams and stud risks.

bees.name: Beekeepers and honey producers
bees.desc: Apiaries, honey extraction, packaging and manuka honey exporters
profile: Honey extraction and packing facility on site?
Honey exported or sold to overseas buyers?
Product testing (UMF, methylglyoxal, residues) completed for each batch?

liab: Product liability and contamination
Residues, adulteration and labelling claims. Check the export position, recall cover and testing records.
Bee stings
Sting injury to neighbours or the public near apiaries. Ask about placement, signage and permissions.
mdamage: Hives, honey drums and extraction plant. Check theft from remote sites, fire, flood and disease exclusions (e.g. AFB).

film.name: Film, TV and production companies
film.desc: Film and TV production, video production, studios and post-production
profile: Stunts, pyrotechnics, animals or aerial filming used?
Filming on locations that need permits and public liability?
Production insurance such as negative, faulty stock and cast cover purchased per production?

gen: Production packages cover equipment, negative, faulty stock, cast and props. Check whether they sit under the business policy or a separate package.
liab: Location and public liability
Permits, public injury and damage at locations. Check broker handling of certificates required by councils and landowners.
Stunts and special effects
Stunts, pyrotechnics, animals and drones often have exclusions. Ask for them to be listed.
pi: Copyright and clearances
Music, footage and likeness clearance. Check media liability and errors and omissions cover.

merchants.name: Building supply and trade merchants
merchants.desc: Timber yards, hardware and building supplies, trade suppliers and merchants
profile: Own delivery trucks including crane trucks and forklifts?
Cutting or machining of products such as timber, glass, sheet or tiles?
Staff advise on product selection or specification for builders?
Trade credit extended to builders and contractors?

liab: Product advice and defects
Wrong product or span advice leads to defects and failures. Check products liability, PI for advice and recall exposure.
Yard and delivery injuries
Falling loads, forklifts and truck-mounted cranes. Check yard safety systems and public access.
mdamage: Timber, treated products and outdoor stock are exposed. Ask about separation, theft from yards and storm.
crime: Credit applications and fake orders. Check crime and trade credit exposure.

drones.name: Drone and aviation services
drones.desc: Drone operators, aerial surveys, ag aviation and small aircraft operators
profile: Pilots hold CAA certificates and operations approved where needed?
Flights over people, buildings or controlled airspace?
Drones fitted with tracking, geofencing and flight logs?

liab: Aviation liability exclusions
General liability policies exclude aircraft. Ask for aviation or drone liability and confirm limits, territory and operator conditions.
mdamage: Hull, loss, crash and in-flight damage cover for drones and equipment. Check theft and territorial limits.
pi: Data accuracy
Survey, inspection and mapping accuracy relied on by others. Check PI cover and disclaimers.
